evidence_boundary: Recordings from critically ill terrestrial hospital patients (Beth Israel Deaconess Medical Center). Used strictly for reproducible technical evaluation of telemetry ingestion, missing-value handling, playback determinism, and UI visualization. Does not establish astronaut physiological baselines or validate spaceflight clinical predictions.
